population: Every package record contributing route evidence to a documentary candidate in either frozen state; each state evaluated separately.
priority_sensitivity: All six permutations of conflict, missing exact route and missing formulation; package-link prerequisite held first. Report the route-before-formulation subset separately.
update_tests: insert identical-content package with new source identity
oracles: Independent Python adjacency and SQL joins; shared route-policy adapter; original populations reconciled with practical_analysis; stale-cache negative controls and restoration checks.
missing_identifier_control: Inject a product and package with co-missing authorization; compare guarded admission with unrestricted equality.
acceptance: Exact agreement of all evidence-bearing answers; destructive missingness must add no candidate keys; every eligible record update must invalidate the complete cached answer; restored source state must reproduce its baseline.
interpretation: Valid identifier reassignment is deliberately not assumed detectable by exact equality; report introduced candidate and path occurrences. Not a clinical accuracy reference standard. Counts reuse source records and are dependent engineering trials.
execution: Local SQLite and Python graph-reference cache. Existing native Neo4j refresh evidence remains separate.
scenario_identity: Frozen files remain immutable. Field-level scenarios retain source-record coordinates to isolate dependency changes; per-trial output digests identify the resulting hypothetical answers. No new official source snapshot is claimed.
